name: r5-prio
summary: Climb round 5: graph stream-priority gate + three scheduling-only levers on launcher 166d7aac. (1) device microtest: does a captured CUDA graph honour stream/node priority (backlog flood vs a 48-CTA high-priority probe)? gates the prio variants. (2) DSV41_PRIO_CMP: KV-source qkv_a shard GEMM above the replicated compressor GEMM (prio) or the compressor ordered after it (serial, no gate needed). (3) DSV41_PRIO_SHARED: MoE shared experts on a dedicated high-priority stream (composes with ffnfront GATE_FIRST; standalone t2 says ~0). (4) DSV41_PRIO_ENGRAM_HOIST: Engram wkv local GEMM of layers 1/14 issued at the start of layers 0/13 on a side stream; both all-gathers keep their op, payload and the main stream. Five anchor patches + one new module; every flag default off and inert when off.

flags.name: DSV41_PRIO_CMP
flags.meaning: layers with a compressor (KV sources 2/8/14/20). prio: fi_mxfp8_quant + skinny shard GEMM of qkv_a on a greatest-priority stream (fork before the quant, join before the all-gather, which stays on main); needs the T1 gate. serial: no priority; the compressor torch.mm on aux stream 0 waits for an event recorded on main right after the shard GEMM. Falls back to the live execute_in_parallel call when the r3 shard path is not taken (M > DSV41_QKV_A_SHARD_MAX_M, stock GEMM, first use inside a capture).

flags.name: DSV41_PRIO_SHARED
flags.meaning: SharedExperts._stream = a dedicated greatest-priority stream instead of vLLM's global aux_stream(); same kernels, same input/output events, same join at the FC2 gather-add. Refused (aux_stream kept) if the shared MLP reduces its own output. Needs the T1 gate to do anything.

flags.name: DSV41_PRIO_ENGRAM_HOIST
flags.meaning: Engram layers 1 and 14 (non-batch, TP-gathered rows): Engram.embed (prefetch wait + rows all-gather, main stream) and the wkv quant+GEMM (wkv.quant_method.apply on a least-priority side stream) are issued at the start of the host layer; Engram.forward joins the GEMM's event and issues the wkv output all-gather on main exactly where ColumnParallelLinear.forward did. Decode-sized forwards only (<= DSV41_PRIO_ENGRAM_MAX_TOKENS), never under SP or a breakable (piecewise) capture.

flags.name: DSV41_PRIO_HI
flags.meaning: priority of the high streams (max = torch.cuda.Stream.priority_range()[1])

CMPPRIO_prio.basis: review r5 (t2 q0.2/q4.1/q0.3): the prio_t2.py model (0.05/0.2/0.45) shifts the _q_kv_norm end earlier by the whole skinny wait and clamps per-layer losses at 0; the qkv_a rdma all-gather (ar_kernel_pl 1x512, 96 regs) must stay on main and cannot co-reside with ~5 compressor CTAs/SM, so it meets the ~37 us backlog. <= half the model, and ONLY if T1 PASS; T1 is expected to FAIL (torch instantiates without cudaGraphInstantiateFlagUseNodePriority) -> 0 in serving

CMPPRIO_serial.basis: review r5 (t2): the compressor then starts at skinny's end = when ar_kernel_pl is issued on main, so the ~37 us backlog moves from skinny to the all-gather; the old 35-40 us/step model ignored that and clamped losses

SHPRIO.basis: t2: the shared chain ends 31-81 us before FC2 in every starved layer and the gather-add join wait is <=0.6 us/layer; the cp4 'N640->moe_act' edge (44-92 us/step) is not a true dependency. Value is as GATE_FIRST insurance

ENGRAM_HOIST.basis: t2: wkv GEMM 84-85 us x 2 = 167-170 us/step + quant 5-6 us on the CP (ceiling ~0.8%); DRAM-bound (19.7 MB fp8 at ~234 GB/s, ~85% of GB10 peak) so it takes bandwidth from layer 0/13 almost one-for-one, and the hoist loses the ~6 MB wkv L2 prefetch of the ag4 window; review r5 central 0 to +0.1. Engram prefetch-wait shift a few us at most (t2 _engram_lookup_kernel 3-14 us). Still the best arm: the only lever whose CP removal does not depend on scheduler priority

expected_gain_pct.combined_note: engram-hoist ~0.05 + cmp-serial ~0 + prio/shared 0 while T1 FAILs (expected)
